visual_action: A static image of a graphic designed to look like a Fox News poll. The poll is titled "THE ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL" and presents two pie charts. The first, "Opinion of OBBB?", shows 59% "Oppose" and 38% "Favor". The second, "For your family, OBBB will...", shows 49% "Hurt", 26% "Make No Difference", and 23% "Help". The source is listed as a Fox News Poll conducted in June 2025.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The on-screen overlay text refers to "Trump's bill".

cast.name: Fox News
cast.evidence: The graphic is labeled "FOX NEWS POLL" and the source is cited as "Source: Fox News Poll".

on_screen_text.text: Fox dropped a poll showing that a MAJORITY of Americans hate Trump's bill 🫢

Source: Fox News Poll
Conducted: June 13-16, 2025
Registered Voters +/- 3% Pts.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken audio, only background music.
audio_music: A rhythmic, modern instrumental track, identified as "Better Call Saul Theme Ohio," plays throughout, lending a dramatic and serious tone to the presentation of the poll results.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static image with no edits, cuts, or motion.
manipulation_or_satire: The video displays a fabricated 'Fox News Poll' graphic. The name of the legislation, 'THE ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL,' is a satirical invention designed to mimic and mock Donald Trump's characteristic speaking style. The poll data is presented as factual within this fabricated context to criticize him.
central_claim: A Fox News poll allegedly shows that a majority of Americans oppose Donald Trump's signature bill and believe it would hurt their families.
intended_effect: To persuade the audience that Donald Trump's policies are deeply unpopular, even according to a source often seen as favorable to him, thereby validating opposition to him.
